title: anemone vesicatoria subsp. humilis
intro: Anemone vesicatoria subsp. humilis, commonly known as a type of stinging nettle, is a plant species in the Ranunculaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include relieving pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Anemone vesicatoria subsp. humilis include glycosides, alkaloids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
